description: This Java source file defines an abstract factory class 'ConditionalFactory' used to create conditional elements ('<if>' tags) within a minilang processing framework, supporting extension for custom condition implementations.

classes.name: ConditionalFactory
classes.description: An abstract generic factory class for creating specific Conditional instances based on XML element tags, supporting extension to add new conditions.

methods.name: makeConditional
methods.description: Static method to instantiate a Conditional object based on the given XML element's tag name, using registered factories.

methods.name: createCondition
methods.description: Abstract method that subclasses must implement to create a Conditional object from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Abstract method that subclasses implement to specify the name of the condition they handle.
